metadata.updateSource: Example Cloud Works compliance pipeline (automated nightly build)

portsAndProtocols.purpose: Agency users and API clients reach the service over HTTPS.
Application tier to the managed PostgreSQL database inside the private network.

securityControls.controlImplementationDescription: Accounts are provisioned only through the agency's SSO; inactive accounts are disabled after 90 days by an automated job.
Every user authenticates with phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2 or PIV) through the agency identity provider.

parameterValues.parameterValue: continuously, and within 24 hours of a new critical advisory

securityControls.controlImplementationDescription: Container images and hosts are scanned continuously; authenticated scanning of the managed database tier is planned for Q1 2027.

ksiImplementation: Passwordless FIDO2 or PIV through agency SSO for all users; no local passwords exist.
ksiValidation: A daily job lists any account without a phishing-resistant authenticator; the list has been empty since launch.
ksiAssessment: The assessor attempted password and SMS sign-in and confirmed both are refused.

ksiEvidence.evidenceDescription: Daily authenticator inventory for all tenants.

ksiImplementation: Application, database and cloud-control-plane logs stream to a central log store with 12 months of retention.
ksiValidation: Alerting fires when a log source stops reporting for 15 minutes.
ksiAssessment: The assessor confirmed every in-scope source appears in the log store.

ksiImplementation: Release images are signed and verified before deployment; configuration files are not yet signed.
ksiValidation: The deployer refuses an unsigned image.
ksiAssessment: The assessor attempted to deploy an unsigned image and confirmed the refusal.

ksiEvidence.evidenceDescription: Deployer log showing an unsigned image rejected.
